intro.title: Controlled DatePicker
intro.body: In this lesson, you will build a controlled DatePicker component in Vue. You will learn how to manage a selected date using Vue's reactive state and how to update it based on user input. The core concept is controlling a component's state through props and events, ensuring the parent component manages the data. You will use Vue's ref for state, v-model for two-way binding, and handle date selection with a custom event. This teaches you how to create reusable, predictable form components in Vue.
intro.usecase: Controlled date pickers are essential in any form where users need to input or schedule dates, such as booking flights on travel websites, setting appointments in healthcare applications, or selecting delivery dates in e-commerce checkouts. They are also critical in data dashboards and reporting tools, allowing users to filter analytics by specific date ranges to view trends over time. As a developer, implementing a controlled date picker ensures the selected date is properly synchronized with your application's state, enabling validation, dynamic UI updates, and reliable data submission.
